prompt: What was the first elected position of the official that was in the office before Steven C. Johnson became the 42nd Kansas State Treasurer?
answer: Lynn Rogers, Steven C. Johnson’s predecessor as Kansas state treasurer, first held elected office as a member of the **Wichita Board of Education (Wichita school board)**.
